items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I loaned him to Tony Almerica to play on his show

ctx.x: over with I know he gets tired I have two records here that he made with Brunus and I don't know if those are the two that he made with them I made some records with Brunus now let me see honey would you know the two records if I gave them to you let me see where
I don't think we have them here I loaned him to Tony Almerica to play on his show and he said that the arm was too heavy for the record that the record was cut up too fast
I have two here honey would you know the sides you made with them yeah I know if I made them or not
